deals.evidence: Seattle's ownership group, led by David Bonderman, a private equity CEO, will pay a $650 million expansion fee
deals.headline: NHL approves Seattle as 32nd franchise for a $650m expansion fee
deals.investor: Seattle Hockey Partners (led by David Bonderman)
deals.summary: The Board of Governors unanimously approved the NHL Seattle group's application; the group, led by private equity CEO David Bonderman, paid a $650 million expansion fee and began play in 2021-22.

deals.evidence: The Seattle ownership group will break ground on a privately financed $800 million renovation of the arena Wednesday
deals.headline: Privately financed rebuild of KeyArena into Climate Pledge Arena
deals.investor: Oak View Group and the Kraken ownership
deals.summary: The ownership group broke ground on a privately financed $800 million renovation of Seattle Center Arena (now Climate Pledge Arena), per NHL.com at the time of the expansion vote; Oak View Group partnered on the project.

deals.evidence: One Roof Sports and Entertainment will become the majority owner of Climate Pledge Arena
deals.headline: Kraken ownership takes majority of Climate Pledge Arena from OVG
deals.investor: One Roof Sports and Entertainment (Samantha Holloway)
deals.summary: Kraken ownership launches One Roof Sports and Entertainment as parent brand and agrees a pre-planned transition under which it becomes majority owner of Climate Pledge Arena; OVG keeps a significant minority stake and operates the venue. Terms not disclosed.

chief_executive.evidence: Current Seattle Kraken CEO Tod Leiweke will also lead One Roof Sports & Entertainment
chief_executive.name: Tod Leiweke
chief_executive.title: CEO, Seattle Kraken and One Roof Sports & Entertainment

founded_evidence: The NHL Board of Governors voted unanimously Tuesday to approve the expansion application from the NHL Seattle group
name: Seattle Kraken
notes: US team: no published accounts; revenue, operating income (EBITDA) and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2024-25; valuation is Forbes enterprise value calculated December 2025 (Forbes lists owners Tod Leiweke, Samantha Holloway; year purchased 2018, price $650M). Holloway's percentage is not stated ('majority owner'); David Bonderman's stake/estate and other minority partners (not read on a citable page) are omitted. Founded = 2018 expansion approval (NHL.com article dated Dec 4, 2018); first season 2021-22. Boardroom (Dec 12, 2022) states Holloway joined her father as an equal co-owner. Missing: arena capacity (NHL.com 2018 said approximately 17,400 planned; no official current figure read), social, attendance, sponsors, net debt, chair.
ownership_summary: Majority-owned by Samantha Holloway, who leads the ownership group (Seattle Hockey Partners, LLC) and its 2026 parent brand One Roof Sports and Entertainment; she became an equal co-owner with her father, TPG co-founder David Bonderman, in December 2022. The franchise was awarded in 2018 to the group led by Bonderman for a $650 million expansion fee.
revenue_source_name: Forbes (estimate), The Business of Hockey, December 2025

stadium_owner.detail: One Roof Sports and Entertainment (the Kraken ownership's parent brand) became majority owner of the arena in March 2026; Oak View Group keeps a significant minority stake and operates it. Sits at Seattle Center.
